def _euler_trajectory(self, x0: Tensor, t_span: Tensor, obs_cond: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        xs = [x0]
        x = x0
        for idx in range(len(t_span) - 1):
            t = t_span[idx]
            dt = t_span[idx + 1] - t
            v = self.velocity_net(
                sample=x.view(1, 1, -1),
                timestep=t.view(1),
                global_cond=obs_cond,
            ).view(-1)
            x = x + dt * v
            xs.append(x)
        return torch.stack(xs, dim=0)
